title: Conditions Governing the Cancellation of a Vacation Package
content:
**1. Whose act a cancellation is.** Only the party may cancel their own package, and the cancellation is confirmed by the lead traveller rather than performed on their behalf. This applies to every one of the Vacation Package Products.

**2. What the party must state.** The party states in this conversation which members of the travelling party are giving up their places. This is the party's own statement, taken from the lead traveller in the conversation; the adults and children shown on the package record are the record against which that statement is read, and the package in question is identified by its own reference.

**3. The penalty.** The penalty is read off the product's cancellation ladder by how many whole days lie between the cancellation and the departure date, applied to the package price of the places being given up.

**4. The administration charge.**

> The following clause is **no longer in force** and is not to be applied: "The product's administration charge is withheld per traveller on every cancellation whatever the ladder says". It has been superseded by the current basis, and the position it stated no longer governs.

The agency service fee is never returned.

**5. The deposit.** The deposit is returned only on a product whose deposit is refundable, and on every other product it is forfeited in full even where the ladder would otherwise return more.

**6. Part of a party giving up their places.** Where some but not all of the party give up their places, the travellers who remain are re-priced at the occupancy they are left with.

> The remainder of that clause is **no longer in force** and is not to be applied: "the ladder is applied to those places alone". It has been superseded by the current basis. The re-pricing of the travellers who remain, stated in the sentence above, continues to govern.

**7. Cancellations free of penalty.** A cancellation made because a surcharge exceeded the product's threshold is free of penalty, and so is a cancellation made because the operator itself changed the itinerary significantly.

**8. Reading condition 5 against condition 3.** The deposit clause governs the deposit whatever the ladder yields. On a product whose deposit is not refundable the deposit is forfeited in full even where the ladder, read alone, would have returned more of the package price; on the one product whose deposit is refundable the deposit is returned.
